positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Insights & Intelligence / Core AI Platform (Luna, Appstore, Alexa)
positions.description:
GenAI
• Built Luna SQL Assistant, used by 290+ employees across engineering, analytics, and PM; a 10x multiplier for daily workflows per power users.
• Co-designed and built Eva, a multi-agent data analysis system that reduced time-to-insight from a 29-day avg (manual ticket-based requests) to under 2 minutes via natural language queries over the data warehouse. 61% adoption. Built with auto sub-agent delegation, prompt caching, LLM-as-a-judge evals, and input/output guardrails (LangGraph, Claude, Redshift).
• Implemented LLM fine-tuning (LoRA) and agentic automation workflows.

ML, Personalization, and Inventions
• Built prototype real-time (16fps) edge-optimized visual scene analysis of video with 3D point mapping (OpenCV, YOLO26, Claude, Depth Anything, IoU).
• Led design and implementation of customer-facing personalized recommendations and product ranking, increasing worldwide engagement by 1.33% and up to 6.35% in some marketplaces. Reduced ML training hours by 86.7% while maintaining model performance.
• Built propensity models to identify high-value customer actions, shaping marketing strategy for 2 years.
• 9 first-author invention disclosures; a novel tranche-based approach for context-specific video segmentation for latency-sensitive streaming won org's "Lunavation" award.

Infrastructure & Analytics
• Derived mathematical models quantifying impact of latency in cloud streaming (e.g., subscription conversion drops 100bps per X ms latency, 30-day retention drops 100bps per Y ms latency).
• Designed and built multi-tenancy into entitlement system, used to onboard multiple Amazon businesses (Alexa, AppStore, Twitch).
• Designed high-level architecture for Luna's data lake and data warehouse, establishing the org's foundational data platform across Engineering, Product, BizDev, Marketing, QA, Privacy, & Legal.
• Created trend prediction system removing seasonality and surfacing multi-year business trends.
• Led GDPR compliance across 189+ datasets.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• 3 patent filings (1 issued) and 3 commercialized products in under 2.5 years.
• Invented core technology for the Flex HD Inspection System, producing over 350% higher dynamic range than company's previous technology. Used in over 15 pharmaceutical lab studies in its first 9 months, generating over 14 TB of data. Further improved SNR with super-resolution techniques.
• Developed GPU-based vision backend for EVO high-speed online inspection system, generating a 12-fold speed increase over CPU-only implementation.
• Built core vision technology powering the Flex P Non-Destructive Particle Imaging System, generating $198k in gross revenue in its first introductory quarter.
• Built 3 additional Flex product lines (P2, M, BLTN) from the ground up.
• Developed ML-based detection of non-free floating particulate matter embedded in drug containers.

• Lead software engineer for VideoWeb, a 51-camera wireless research network with 3 mobile multi-sensor robots and an on-site 128-core server back end.
• Led development of the College of Engineering Faculty Search application, reducing department workload from 5 full-time employees to 1 part-time.
